g.text: Figure 5 mechanism: parameter changes propagate through EDL charging to mixed-potential outputs

text.style: fill: #767676; font: 7px 'Helvetica', 'Nimbus Sans', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each column varies one parameter only. Dashed horizontal lines mark the Figure 5 baseline; dashed vertical lines in the bottom rows mark the w/o EDL output.

text.style: fill: #767676; font: 7px 'Helvetica', 'Nimbus Sans', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Scan direction is vertical from low to high parameter value; low/base/high labels give the exact row-quantity values at those three points.
